description: I ordered a SAMSUNG washing machine for 17400 UAH. NOVA POSHTA delivered it on 2025-10-18 in a sealed box and I did not open it at the branch. At home I found small shrapnel holes in the box and the washing machine casing is punctured. The washing machine is damaged and unsafe, and I do not know whether it was hit at the SAMSUNG warehouse or during delivery.
documentText: NOVA POSHTA waybill 20450777654321, sender SAMSUNG distribution warehouse Brovary, delivered 2025-10-18, parcel sealed. Photos: 3 photos of holes in the box and casing (not attached).
